title: G16-backed safeguarded tangent coupling orchestration and final publication seam
question: Can the qualified G16 immutable-origin tangent-observation service be used by the unchanged research E3/P4 controller to recover the frozen G11 live Newton overshoot, while keeping every diagnostic/probe/safeguard trial non-authoritative and allowing only one explicitly reacquired final FMR candidate to enter the existing preflight/ledger/publication path?

scope.admitted_subject: Research orchestration semantics across G16 observation service, frozen E3/P4 logic, final FMR candidate reacquisition, existing FMR preflight and groundwater-interface ledger publication seam.
live_components: live MODFLOW6 proposal/groundwater-response solves used by the frozen G11 research oracle
explicit_limitations: The live MODFLOW solves remain the existing research proposal/merit oracle and are not themselves a persistent transactional MODFLOW participant commit.
Sequential SWAP commit followed by ledger commit is not claimed crash-atomic merely because both preflights pass.
E3 and P4 remain research policy logic outside production runtime authority.
No HCOF/RHS production policy change is admitted.

frozen_controller.central_rule: Use h-d and h+d only when both status-0/candidate-ready observations share one execution class.
frozen_controller.backward_rule: Use h, h-d and h-2d only when all share one execution class.
frozen_controller.forward_rule: Use h, h+d and h+2d only when all share one execution class.
frozen_controller.multiscale_gate: First adjacent valid candidate pair with relative slope difference <= 0.05; select the coarser.

orchestration_contract: Initialize and capture one immutable FMR origin; accepted revision/time and committed ledger snapshot define the authority baseline.
Begin one G16 session and use only G16 observe_head for all SWAP-side current-head, E3 stencil, raw-Newton and P4 safeguard diagnostic evaluations.

After every G16 observation the participant must have no live candidate, FMR preflight must be false, ledger preflight must be false, and committed revision/time/ledger snapshot must equal the origin baseline.
Status-6 observations are diagnostic only with q unavailable and may trigger P4 contraction; they must not leak candidate-busy state.
Within the G16 session exact-head repeats may be served from cache; every unique prescribed head causes at most one participant physical trial.
After research P4 convergence, retain the cached final observation only as diagnostic evidence, end the G16 session, and prove no publication authority exists yet.
Reacquire the converged head exactly once through the ordinary participant trial path outside G16. This is the sole candidate allowed to become live/publication-ready.
The reacquired final trial must reproduce the cached final diagnostic q within 1e-18 m/s.
Only after final-candidate FMR preflight passes may the interface ledger be prepared. Ledger preflight must pass while committed state remains unchanged.
Then execute the existing nominal publication order: participant commit followed by prepared-ledger commit. No claim of crash atomicity follows from this nominal-path test.
A fresh-process direct-publication control at the exact converged head must reproduce the same committed revision/time/ledger count and ledger exchange.
quantitative_gates: Frozen G11 first raw proposal remains participant status 6 and agrees with the persisted G11 raw head within 1e-12 m.
P4 performs exactly two factor-1/2 contractions and converges with |residual| <= 1e-15 m/s.
Final converged head agrees with persisted G11 final head within 1e-12 m.
For the entire diagnostic solve, service logical_requests = participant_trials + cache_hits and participant_trials = unique cached heads.
No diagnostic G16 call returns or leaves a live participant candidate.
No diagnostic call changes accepted revision/time or committed ledger count/exchange.
Immediately before final reacquisition FMR preflight and ledger preflight are both false.
Final reacquisition uses exactly one ordinary participant trial and leaves a live candidate before commit.
Cached-final versus reacquired-final q difference <= 1e-18 m/s.
Ledger committed exchange equals the final trial bottom_outward_exchange_cm * 0.01 within floating-point roundoff.
Fresh-process direct-publication control is equivalent to the orchestrated final publication state.
pass_interpretation: PASS qualifies only the research orchestration and existing FMR/ledger publication seam under the frozen G11 safeguard-recovery stress. It demonstrates diagnostic non-authority and final-candidate handoff. It does not production-admit E3, P4, persistent MODFLOW transaction publication, crash-atomic multi-participant commit, or HCOF/RHS policy.
fail_interpretation: Preserve technical failures separately from scientific/ownership failures. Do not weaken G16 ownership, G11 safeguard behavior, E3 rules, convergence tolerances or publication gates retrospectively.
allowed_mutation: .github/workflows/gc-real-fgc44-semantic-scan.yml only if needed to execute G17
forbidden_mutation: src/runtime coupling policy or HCOF/RHS implementation
G09D/G13 E3 thresholds, scale ladder or stencil rules
G11 P4 safeguard factor, tolerances or groundwater stress
